caption: “Nimbostratus,” from International Atlas of Clouds and of States of the Sky (Paris, France: Office National Meteorologique. 1930), p. 14.
alt: A printed page defining nimbostratus: “A low, amorphous, and rainy layer, of a dark grey colour and nearly uniform; feebly illuminated seemingly from inside.”
bibliography: "Nimbostratus." International Atlas of Clouds and of States of the Sky, Office National Météorologique, 1930.
